mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 32 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, under the light of a Waning Gibbous moon.

City Hall reminds residents that the 2027 Spring Election cycle has begun. Candidates for all four Aldermanic Districts must return their required paperwork to the City Clerk by 5:00 p.m. on January 5, 2027.

There is plenty happening around town today, including the Crafty Fair at ART House 360 and live music performances at both Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia nights next week at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and The Bogey Factory.
Regarding local public safety, on November 8, a single-vehicle crash on South Main Street led to an arrest for O W I after the vehicle struck a tree and caught fire.
Today's flavor of the day is the refreshing Mint Cookie. The store is closed right now but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
